standard-dialogue-before-delivering-the-.npc: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.
Enjoy your stay here. May it be spiritually uplifting!

standard-dialogue-after-delivering-the-h.npc: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.

steps.player: Do you have any more paint?

steps.npc: Certainly. How much do you want?

steps.text: The High Priest hands you over some paint.

steps.npc: Enjoy your stay here. May it be spiritually uplifting!

delivering-the-holy-sheet-to-the-priest.player: Hey, I have something you might be interested in...

delivering-the-holy-sheet-to-the-priest.text: You show the sheet to the High Priest.

delivering-the-holy-sheet-to-the-priest.npc: Ah! A blessed sheet! This is perfect, I've been feeling rather cold the last few nights! As a token of my gratitude, I'm sure we can spare some paint for you.

delivering-the-holy-sheet-to-the-priest.text: The High Priest swaps the holy sheet for a bucket of paint.

delivering-the-holy-sheet-to-the-priest.npc: If you'd like more paint, please ask for it. I'm sure we can spare you some.

delivering-the-old-man-s-message.npc: Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.

delivering-the-old-man-s-message.player: I've got a message for you from the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village.

delivering-the-old-man-s-message.npc: How kind of you to bring me a message to this remote island!

steps.text: The High Priest gives you some coins.

steps.npc: I don't have much in the way of wealth, but I can spare you a few coins for your trouble.

delivering-the-old-man-s-message.text: If the player receives Prayer experience:

steps.text: The High Priest blesses you.  You gain some Prayer xp.

steps.npc: In the name of Saradomin I shall bless you...

delivering-the-old-man-s-message.text: If the player receives some herbs:

steps.npc: Here, let me give you some herbs.

steps.text: The High Priest gives you some banknotes that can be exchanged for herbs.

delivering-the-old-man-s-message.text: If the player receives a gem:

steps.npc: The beasts which dwell under this island occasionally drop gems when they die - please take this one as a sign of my gratitude.

options.text: If the player receives an uncut emerald:

steps.text: The High Priest gives you an uncut emerald!

options.text: If the player receives an uncut diamond:

steps.text: The High Priest gives you an uncut diamond!

options.text: If the player receives an uncut red topaz:

steps.text: The High Priest gives you an uncut red topaz!

options.text: If the player receives an uncut sapphire:

steps.text: The High Priest gives you an uncut sapphire!

delivering-the-old-man-s-message.npc: Enjoy your stay here. May it be spiritually uplifting!

using-any-other-items-on-the-high-priest.npc: No thank you, I am not accepting donations for the church at this time.
